question: If the speed of a wave is 300 m/s and its wavelength is 0.75 m, the frequency of the wave is _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3: 400 Hz**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **speed of a wave** is related to its frequency and wavelength by the formula: **v = f × λ**, where:

 
 
• **v** is the speed of the wave (in meters per second, m/s).
 
• **f** is the frequency of the wave (in Hertz, Hz).
 
• **λ** (lambda) is the wavelength of the wave (in meters, m).
 
 
 
• In the given problem:
 
 
• **Speed of the wave (v) = 300 m/s**
 
• **Wavelength (λ) = 0.75 m**
 
 
 
• To find the frequency (**f**), rearrange the formula: **f = v / λ**.
 
• Substitute the given values:
 
 
• **f = 300 / 0.75**
 
• **f = 400 Hz**
 
 
 
• **Hence, the correct frequency of the wave is 400 Hz**,
